sources.document_title: TLV755P 500mA, Low-IQ, Small-Size, Low-Dropout Regulator datasheet
sources.locator: SBVS320D physical PDF page 17 of 51 (index 16), printed page 17 and continuation on printed page 18: Section 7.1.4 Reverse Current and Figure 7-3
sources.evidence_extract: 7.1.4 Reverse Current: 'As with most LDOs, excessive reverse current potentially damages this device.' Reverse current flows through the pass-transistor body diode and at high magnitude degrades long-term reliability (electromigration, excessive heat dissipation, potential latch-up). Listed conditions (large COUT with collapsing input and little load; output biased while the input is not established; output biased above the input) 'all of which exceed the absolute maximum rating of VOUT > VIN + 0.3V'. Printed page 18: 'If reverse current flow is expected in the application, use external protection to protect the device.' Figure 7-3: example protection with a Schottky diode from OUT to IN. No allowed reverse current or duration is given. Text layer read with pdftotext -layout from the 2026-11-11 bytes (43ff53fb...).
